### What and why

Add a short "Drift rules" section to the docs page that names the NOT_LINKED rule and gives a made-up example.

### Acceptance criteria

- `public/docs/index.html` has a "Drift rules" section.
- It names NOT_LINKED and gives a made-up example with a fictional key such as DEMO-12.
- No scripts are added, and no other files change.
